messages.subject: change background color
parts: How can I change the white default background color of a shiny app?  Is html necessary?  Thanks.

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: change background color
parts:
If you are using page with sidebar layout, you can add CSS tags to modify styles of specific elements of your app.
Try this (in ui.r)
        sidebarPanel
        (
            tags$head(
                tags$style("body {background-color: black; }")
            )
                 #Sidebar controls
                  )

I suggest placing all your style tags in a separate file and referencing it with tags$link inside tags$head. e.g:
tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css", href="styles.css")
